nodes.name: Insert Keywords History
nodes.notes: Runs BEFORE Get Recently Posted (sequential, not parallel) so that this run's rows are guaranteed to exist -- with their DB id -- by the time Pick Next Keyword looks them up.

nodes.name: Get Recently Posted
nodes.notes: Fetches ALL rows -- both the cooldown filtering and today's row-id lookup happen in the next Code node, to avoid depending on Supabase filter-param schema (which varies by n8n version).

parameters.text:
=오늘의 트렌드 키워드 후보: *{{ $json.keyword }}*
(검색량: {{ $json.approx_traffic || '정보없음' }})

이 키워드로 포스팅을 진행할까요?

({{ $json.attempt }}/5번째 요청 · {{ $json.attempt === 1 ? 3 : 5 }}분 내 미응답 시 재전송, 5회째까지 무응답이면 자동 승인됩니다)

nodes.name: Send Telegram Keyword Approval
nodes.notes: VERIFY IN UI: this inlineKeyboard structure matches n8n's Telegram node UI-driven format, but field names can still shift between versions. If buttons don't render after import, open Reply Markup and confirm the two buttons + their URL values are intact. NOTE: once a retry fires, only the LATEST message's buttons are valid -- earlier messages' buttons point to a superseded wait instance.

nodes.name: Wait Keyword Approval
nodes.notes: VERIFY IN UI: open this node, confirm Resume=On Webhook Call, then toggle 'Limit Wait Time' ON, Limit Type=After Time Interval, and check the Amount field accepts the expression above (switch it to expression/fx mode if it was imported as a plain number).

nodes.name: IF Approval Retry
nodes.notes: true -> loops back to Keyword Approval Attempt with attempt+1. false here means outcome was 'rejected' -- ends silently, same as before.

nodes.name: Get Rows For Approval Lookup
nodes.notes: Fetches all rows -- filtering to the pending one happens in the next Code node, same pattern as Get Recently Posted.

nodes.name: Resolve Pending Approval
nodes.notes: Same mechanism as the inline keyboard buttons (a GET to $execution.resumeUrl), just triggered from a typed reply instead of a button click. If this errors, most likely the Wait instance already resumed (button was clicked first) or the retry loop moved past it -- check onError below wasn't needed since a failure here just means the message came too late.

parameters.text: ={{ $('Find Pending Resume URL').item.json.decision === 'approve' ? '✅ 코멘트 반영해서 초안 작성을 진행할게요.' : '❌ 거절 처리했습니다.' }}{{ $('Find Pending Resume URL').item.json.comment ? '\n\n남기신 코멘트: ' + $('Find Pending Resume URL').item.json.comment : '' }}

nodes.name: Search Naver News
nodes.notes: sort=date so the most recent articles come first, required for the recency filter next. VERIFY IN UI: re-enter your real X-NCP-APIGW-API-KEY-ID/SECRET here after import -- the committed JSON keeps placeholders since this repo is public.

nodes.name: Send Telegram News Review
nodes.notes: Same inlineKeyboard structure as the other approval node -- verify buttons survive import. Once a retry fires, only the LATEST message's buttons are valid.

nodes.name: Store Pending Resume URL
nodes.notes: Persists this attempt's resume URL so a free-text '승인: 코멘트' Telegram reply can resume this exact Wait instance later. Runs on every retry attempt, so it always holds the latest live resume URL.

nodes.name: Wait News Review
nodes.notes: VERIFY IN UI: same as Wait Keyword Approval -- confirm Limit Wait Time toggle + expression-mode Amount field survive import.

nodes.name: IF News Retry
nodes.notes: true -> loops back to News Review Attempt with attempt+1. false means outcome was 'rejected' -> Telegram: News Review Rejected.

nodes.name: Claude Draft
nodes.notes: References 'Build News Summary' by name (not $json) because $json here is the Wait node's resumed payload, not the news summary.

nodes.name: Send Email Draft
nodes.notes: TEMPORARY fallback while WordPress publishing is broken. Once WordPress works again, swap this (and Mark Handled below) back for Publish WordPress + preview-link + final-approval + publish/delete, per git history.

nodes.name: Mark Handled
nodes.notes: Sets posted_at (no wp_post_id, since nothing was actually published) so the 14-day cooldown logic still prevents re-emailing the same keyword every 3 hours.
